name: L. A. Huffman
role: Miles City photographer of round-up views
bio: L. A. Huffman was the Miles City photographer whose series of instantaneous views of stock ranches and round-up scenes the paper announced in August 1885. The Cow Boy sold sets of thirty-six of his round-up photographs through 1886, reporting in October that it had sold nearly forty sets in three months.

moments.label: Began a photographic series of ranches and round-ups
His round-up views sold nearly forty sets
